taiwan.whatIs: A Bib Gourmand is the MICHELIN Guide's pick of places serving good food at a moderate price: in Taiwan, three good courses for under NT$1,000 (about US$31), drinks not included. It isn't a star; Bib Gourmand restaurants are chosen by the same inspectors but listed apart from the starred ones, and they range from street stalls to small bistros.
taiwan.whatIsZh: 必比登推介是米其林指南推薦「物有所值」美食的評選：在台灣，代表以新台幣 1,000 元以下（不含飲料）就能吃到三道好料理。必比登不是星級，由同一批評審選出，但和星級餐廳分開列出，從路邊小吃攤到小酒館都有。
taiwan.next: Michelin names Taiwan's Bib Gourmands about a week before its star ceremony, usually in July or August: the 2026 list came out on 14 July, a week before the stars on 21 July. We'll update this page when the 2027 list is out.
taiwan.nextZh: 米其林通常在星級頒獎典禮前約一週公布台灣的必比登名單，多在 7 月或 8 月：2026 年名單於 7 月 14 日公布，比 7 月 21 日的星級名單早一週。2027 年名單公布後，我們會更新這一頁。
